name: mummy lord
lore:
Ancient evils stir beneath the sands, their withered forms animated by dark rituals and unholy power. These are the mummy lords, once mighty figures in life, now undead rulers of desolate tombs and forgotten temples. Their eyes burn with malevolent intelligence, and their touch brings the chillingRot, a disease that consumes the living and binds them to eternal servitude.

Imagine stepping into the domain of a mummy lord: a place where shadows dance with malice, where the very air crackles with negative energy. Divination spells falter, offering only glimpses of twisted truths, and any sustenance brought within withers to dust. The mummy lord, adorned with the decaying regalia of their former glory, commands legions of lesser undead, their loyalty fueled by fear and dark magic. Their canopic heart, hidden deep within the tomb, beats with unlife, a constant source of regeneration that can only be extinguished by the purifying embrace of fire.

But be warned, for the lairs of mummy lords are not merely tombs, they are prisons of the soul. Those who dare disturb their slumber risk incurring ancient curses, binding them to the whims of the undead pharaoh. Only by returning stolen artifacts and cleansing the tomb of its unholy taint can these curses be lifted, freeing the afflicted from their agonizing fate. Tread carefully, adventurers, for in the realm of the mummy lord, death is only the beginning.
